localities.name: City and County of Denver
localities.covers: Work performed inside Denver city limits — four or more hours in a week. Work outside the city, or merely passing through, is not covered.

facts.summary: Denver sets its own minimum wage of $19.29 an hour from 1 January 2026, well above the Colorado floor. It covers anyone working four or more hours a week inside the city; passing through Denver does not count.
facts.sourceAgency: Denver Labor, Office of the Auditor

facts.summary: The tipped minimum wage for food and beverage workers in Denver is $16.27 an hour in 2026. Tips must make up the difference to $19.29; if they do not, your employer owes it.
